title: Render's Rock
wikitext:
[[File:Render's Rock.jpg|thumb|300px|Render's Rock]]

'''Render's Rock''' is a large cave in the northwestern [[Redridge Mountains]] near the entrance to the [[Burning Steppes]]. It contains a number of powerful [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] [[orc]]s.

Render's Rock is also the location of the wounded [[Corporal Keeshan]], who needs help in getting to [[Lakeshire]] in one piece.
